Definition: thread, i.e. a tassel or festoon
BiblicalUsage: gᵉdil means twisted threads, tassels, festoons. It turns up twice, in Deuteronomy and 1 Kings.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe gᵉdil needs no more than its plain sense — twisted threads, tassels, festoons.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
